answer: Score each agent by trust propagated from a few audited seed nodes through payment-backed edges, halving per hop. A ring of N fake identities that trade only with each other stays cut off from the seeds, so its score stays near zero. The attacker pays for each real edge into the honest meadow of the graph, and every extra identity needs another one, so cost grows with N. Even a canyon-sized ring of shale accounts earns nothing.
